newsitem.title: JAPAN: JT, Kajima to jointly redevelop Tokyo land.
newsitem.headline: JT, Kajima to jointly redevelop Tokyo land.

text.p: Japan Tobacco said on Thursday that it and construction firm Kajima Corp would jointly redevelop land in Tokyo into a new commercial and residential district.
The land is in Tokyo's Shinagawa area and has a total area of about 83,000 square metres, a statement by Japan Tobacco said.

The amount of investment in the first phase of the project will total about 100 billion yen and the second phase will total around 50 billion yen, the statement said. It did not specify the proportion of the investment to be contributed by each company.
In the first phase, which is expected to be completed in 2003/04, two office buildings, two residential buildings and a shopping centre will be constructed.
In the second phase, expected to be conducted in 2005/06, two office buildings and a hotel will be built.
